_why: v3.73 (Phase A.1) — 65 undesigned, 39 unmigrated (was 132 / 19). The drop is not work on the CSS: the design system now knows 45 colours instead of 24, so 67 literals moved from 'in no design token' to 'a token written as a literal'. Two changes did it. design-system/tokens.json models the light theme at last — that is Phase A.1, open since v0.9 — and the linter reads it, which it could not before because the theme block is a flat path->value map and _walk only reached nested {value:...} leaves. That reader gap is why v3.72's figure went UP for adding two correct values. The other change is bigger: fifteen of the sixteen role tokens held a DARK value the product had stopped shipping — the warm palette (#161310, #f3ede1) that v2.21 replaced with an achromatic set so the surround could not tint colour judgment. Phase A.1 was about to add a second theme to a file that was wrong about the first. Both themes are measured out of a rendered page now (scripts/measure_theme_tokens.py) and compared in the browser lane. Raise it again only with a reason here.
